import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# The experiment is a package under the repository root, which a document
# rendered from this directory does not have on its path.
REPOSITORY = Path.cwd().resolve().parents[1]
if str(REPOSITORY) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(REPOSITORY))

from sipnet_calibration.plotting.style import use_project_style

# The project style, scaled up for slides.
use_project_style()
plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.dpi": 200,
    "figure.figsize": (14, 7),
    "font.size": 15,
    "axes.titlesize": "large",
    "axes.labelsize": "medium",
    "xtick.labelsize": "small",
    "ytick.labelsize": "small",
    "legend.fontsize": "small",
    "legend.title_fontsize": "medium",
})
